sentences.text: ----Respondent(S) on 7 October, 2024
Author: Arindam Lodh Bench: Arindam Lodh

HIGH COURT OF TRIPURA  AGARTALA  B.A. 53/2024 Smt. Bholu Dey on behalf of accused person in custody Sri Debasish Dey  ----Applicant(s)
 Versus The State of Tripura ----Respondent(s)
For Applicant(s) : Mr. S. Sarkar, Sr. Advocate Mr. KD Singha, Advocate For Respondent(s) : Mr.
Raju Datta, PP Mr. S. Ghosh, Addl
. PP HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE ARINDAM LODH Order 07/10/2024
Heard Mr. S. Sarkar, learned senior counsel assisted by Mr. KD Singha, learned counsel appearing for the applicant.
Also heard Mr. Raju Datta, learned PP appearing for the respondent-State.

This is an application filed under Section 439 Cr.P.C. for granting bail to the accused, Debasish Dey, who has been in custody since 08.03.2024 in connection with RK Pur PS case no. 2023 RKP 133 registered under Sections 420/34 of the IPC.

When the matter is taken up,
learned senior counsel appearing for the applicant has submitted that in terms of the Order dated 15.07.2024 passed by this court the accused has deposited Rs.5 lakh out of Rs.12 lakh to the person concerned, and thus, he has prayed for releasing the accused on bail.
Learned senior counsel has also assured this court that the accused will repay the balance amount of Rs.7 lakh to the person concerned within 2 (two) months.
To establish his submission, learned senior counsel has placed on record an affidavit sworn by the applicant i.e. father of the accused.
Learned PP has submitted that the accused may be released on bail on condition that he will pay the balance amount of Rs.7 lakh within a period of 2(two) months.
I have gone through the case record and the affidavit sworn by father of the accused which has been placed by learned senior counsel before this court.
In view of the above, I am inclined to grant bail to the accused.

Accordingly, the accused, namely, Sri Debasish Dey, shall be released on bail on executing a bond of Rs.25,000/- with one surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of learned Elaka Magistrate,
Udaipur, Gomati Judicial District.

entities.text:
Elaka Magistrate,
Udaipur, Gomati Judicial District
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: It is further directed that the accused-person shall appear before the Investigating Officer once in a week.
It is made clear that if within the stipulated period, the accused fails to deposit the balance amount of Rs.7 lakh, the bail granted to the accused shall be treated as cancelled.

With the above observation and directions, the instant bail application stands Smt. Bholu Dey On Behalf Of Accused ... vs The State Of Tripura ----Respondent(S) on 7 October, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/5872494/
1 allowed and thus disposed.
